title_zh: 约定增设社团的非线上报名方式

scenario.label_zh: 调整社团报名规则以减少排斥
scenario.goal_zh: 指出仅限线上报名造成的排斥，并约定增设同等条件的电话报名

context_zh: 社区活动社团的两名组织者检查拟发布的报名规则。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: Our new form is online only. Will that deprive some members of a chance to take part?

sentences.speaker: Idris
sentences.text: Yes. Several people have no internet access. That kind of exclusion is avoidable.

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: I wanted one process for everyone because equality matters.

sentences.speaker: Idris
sentences.text: The same process does not always give everyone the same chance. We should also check the rules for any other discrimination.

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: Could we accept telephone registrations using exactly the same questions and deadline?

sentences.speaker: Idris
sentences.text: Yes, and the same places and prices must be available through both routes.

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: Agreed. I will add the telephone option and those conditions to the notice.
